0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_000010_EDMONT
0.description: To the northern reaches of the Sea of Clouds,<hex:02100103>where countless isles yet remained uncharted...

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_000020_EDMONT
1.description: In search of a mysterious land known as Azys Lla,<hex:02100103>and the unmasked villain who sought to claim its secrets...

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_000030_EDMONT
2.description: Oblivious to the new threat which followed in their wake, they came...

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_200010_IGEYOHRM
7.description: So falls the Lord of Mists, as did all others before him.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_200020_IGEYOHRM
8.description: How many times does this make, Warrior of Light? Ahhh, how much you have grown─far beyond the limits of mere mortals.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_200040_IGEYOHRM
10.description: That <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> does. The key to Azys Lla and the secrets of Allag.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_200050_IGEYOHRM
11.description: I see you have regained the blessing of Light─albeit at a fraction of its former strength.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_200060_THORDAN
12.description: My thanks to you, Ascian─and to you as well, Warrior of Light, for saving us the effort of slaying Bismarck.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_200070_THORDAN
13.description: Now that the key is within our grasp, the path to the heavens shall at last be laid bare!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_200090_THORDAN
15.description: By our deeds shall the wrongs of antiquity be righted, and man reclaim the reins of history!

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300020_ALPHINAUD
17.description: Imperial troops─and they have already secured the area.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300040_REGULA
19.description: And there I was expecting more beastmen. Who are you!?

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300050_VARIS
20.description: I thought Ishgardians responsible for the disappearance of our scouts, but I see now that I was mistaken.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300060_VARIS
21.description: Just as Roaille observed. The Warrior of Light is wont to appear at the most inopportune times.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300070_REGULA
22.description: The Warrior of Light? <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> who bested van Baelsar!?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300080_VARIS
23.description: It would seem that the famous hero of Eorzea seeks Azys Lla as well.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300090_VARIS
24.description: Hardly unexpected. The secrets of the Allagans' power to bind eikons to their will could scarcely fail to interest the Scions of the Seventh Dawn...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300100_VARIS
25.description: You know as well as we what will ensue should these insatiable creatures be allowed to roam free─that their very existence threatens the life of this star. We but disagree on the solution to the problem.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300110_ALPHINAUD
26.description: Genocide has ever been the Empire's favored recourse─and that is why we will continue to oppose your every attempt to claim Eorzea!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300120_VARIS
27.description: You do not hesitate to speak your mind...even when your every word could be your last.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300130_VARIS
28.description: Alas, your sentiments betray the narrowness of your view. The fate of Eorzea and its inhabitants is of little concern next to the fate of the world.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300140_VARIS
29.description: 'Tis my solemn charge as emperor to bring the eikons to heel. If this requires the extermination of certain elements, then so be it.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300150_ALPHINAUD
30.description: No, don't! They are not his thralls!

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300190_VARIS
34.description: We shall meet again, Warrior of Light. On that you have my word.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_300200_ALPHINAUD
35.description: So Garlemald, too, has designs on Azys Lla... But why would the Emperor himself elect to lead the expedition?

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400010_LUCIA
36.description: I did not think that I would ever have occasion to pilot a suit of magitek armor again─least of all under these circumstances.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400020_LUCIA
37.description: My full name is Lucia goe Junius, and I was born a citizen of Garlemald.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400030_CID
38.description: Ah, that explains it! When we first met in Ishgard, I very nearly called you Livia.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400040_ALPHINAUD
39.description: Livia...? Livia sas Junius? The tribunus who served under Gaius van Baelsar!?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400050_LUCIA
40.description: Aye, she was my sister─though we spent little time together. After our parents were killed in an uprising, we were sent to live in different households, setting us on separate paths...

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400060_LUCIA
41.description: Livia felt at home on the battlefield and chose to become a soldier, while I underwent training to become a spy.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400080_LUCIA
43.description: My mission. 'Twas believed that Allagan relics of great worth were stored in the Vault, and I was sent to investigate.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400090_LUCIA
44.description: Though I was given little information at the time, I now suspect I was searching for the key we but recently lost. And then I met Ser Aymeric.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400100_LUCIA
45.description: 'Twas his usefulness to my mission which prompted me to approach him, but I soon found myself drawn to him for other reasons.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400110_LUCIA
46.description: He too was a prisoner of his past─judged for his heritage as a bastard son of the archbishop. Yet unlike my sister and I, he did not curse his fate. He simply rose above it.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400120_LUCIA
47.description: In time, I came to realize that I had found a man worth following, and a new home besides. And when I subsequently confessed all to Ser Aymeric, he was good enough to accept me into his service.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400130_ALPHINAUD
48.description: ...I do not question your loyalty to Ser Aymeric. 'Tis your loyalty to your sister which concerns me.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400140_LUCIA
49.description: I have long been of the opinion that those who dwell in the past risk losing sight of their future.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400150_LUCIA
50.description: My sister fought for her convictions, and for those she held dear. So do I. So must we all.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400160_CID
51.description: Well, I for one am happy to welcome a fellow Garlean to our merry band─especially one who can make magitek armor sing!

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400170_BIGGS
52.description: Chief, we should be getting close.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_400180_WEDGE
53.description: Once we break through those clouds, we'll be right where the light was pointing─right where Azys Lla should be!

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_500030_CID
57.description: Allagan, aye. There's no mistaking their handiwork.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_500060_WEDGE
60.description: She won't hold, Chief! She's breaking up!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_500080_ALPHINAUD
62.description: Cid, it's no use! We must return to Ishgard and find another way!

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03005_500090_CID
63.description: Damn it all! Why do the Allagans always have to make everything so bloody complicated!?
